subject: Customer story prep: Sparkline Health discovery roundtable
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@sparklinehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Customer story prep: Sparkline Health discovery roundtable

Hi Alicia,

Thanks again for agreeing to participate in a customer story with Redwood. We want to run a short discovery roundtable (30 minutes) to capture the usage patterns, business impact, and any metrics you can share — then record a follow-up 60-minute interview for the full case study write-up if that works.

Proposed outcomes for the 30-minute session:
- Quick intro to participants and use cases
- Key metrics and before/after outcomes (cost, latency, developer velocity)
- Which teams/stakeholders should be on the longer interview

I included a draft agenda and our signed NDA for your records. Can you confirm:
1) your preferred time windows next week (PST) for a 30-minute slot?
2) whether Sparkline is comfortable with a brief recorded call (audio + transcript) for internal drafting and editorial review?
3) the stakeholders we should invite to the longer interview?

Attachments: draft-agenda.docx, nda-signed.pdf

If helpful, Monica (CS lead) and Rishi (solutions) are copied — they’ll help with logistics and pull usage data.

Thanks — happy to be flexible on timing.

—
Jasmine Liu
Senior Customer Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@sparklinehealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Blake <t.blake@sparklinehealth.com>, Sparkline Marketing <marketing@sparklinehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Customer story prep: Sparkline Health discovery roundtable

Hi Jasmine — great to connect.

All sounds good. We can do a 30-minute discovery on Tuesday 11/10 at 10:00 AM PT (which is 1:00 PM ET). That works for me and Tom. For the longer interview we expect to bring in our Head of Product (Elena Ruiz) and our Analytics lead (Marcus Chen).

Recording is fine for drafting purposes as long as we get a chance to review quotes and redactions before publication. We have a short legal checklist — I attached the usage metrics export that Rishi asked for (sparkline-usage-stats.csv).

Two small asks:
- Can you include a short paragraph in the invite summarizing how the case study will be used (channels, timeline)?
- We need the draft agenda to include a 10-minute segment on patient privacy/PHI safeguards.

I’ll loop Marketing for approvals on quotes.

Thanks,
Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Head of Customer Success, Sparkline Health
agomez@sparklinehealth.com

Attachments: sparkline-usage-stats.csv

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@sparklinehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Tom Blake <t.blake@sparklinehealth.com>, Sparkline Marketing <marketing@sparklinehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 12:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Customer story prep: Sparkline Health discovery roundtable

Alicia — perfect, thanks for the quick reply and for the export.

I’ll send a calendar invite for Tue 11/10 10:00 AM PT / 1:00 PM ET. Agenda updates:
- 0-5m: Introductions & goals (Redwood + Sparkline)
- 5-15m: Usage highlights and key metrics (we'll reference the CSV)
- 15-25m: Outcomes and customer impact (developer velocity, latency improvements)
- 25-30m: Next steps + consent for recording & editorial review window

Per your ask, I’ll add a blurb in the invite on intended channels (website case study, sales collateral, one-pager) and the timeline: draft to Sparkline for review within 7 business days after the longer interview; final approval required before any public use.

On recording: we will record audio and auto-transcribe. We will not publish verbatim quotes without your approval — you’ll have a chance to review and request edits/redactions. Monica, can you confirm the recording and editorial review process on Redwood's side? Rishi will own the metrics pull for the final draft.

Attach updated draft agenda (added privacy segment) and the invite text I’ll paste below to use for approvals.

Invite paragraph (for approvals):
"Redwood Inference requests a short discovery call (30m) followed by a deeper interview (60m) to capture product usage and outcomes. Content will be used for a customer case study on Redwood's website and sales materials. Sparkline will be given a chance to review and approve quotes before publication."

Attachments: draft-agenda.docx (updated)

Thanks — sending the invite now.

—
Jasmine

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Alicia Gomez <agomez@sparklinehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Tom Blake <t.blake@sparklinehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 02:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Customer story prep: Sparkline Health discovery roundtable

Thanks everyone — calendar invite sent for Tue 11/10 10:00 AM PT (Zoom).

Recording/process note: Redwood records for internal drafting. After the 60-minute interview we will share a draft write-up and a list of proposed quotes. Sparkline will have up to 5 business days to request redactions or edits; we won't publish anything without explicit approval.

Attachments on our side: NDA (signed), agenda (final), metrics export received.

See you Tuesday — Zoom link in the calendar invite.

—
Monica Patel
Customer Success Lead, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
